# Scena Growth

> Scena Growth makes premium brands known and makes them sell between France and the UAE, in both directions: your marketing and sales team, without opening a subsidiary.

## Key facts
- Websites: English https://www.scenagrowth.com ; French https://www.scenagrowth.fr
- Markets: France; United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi); wider GCC
- Directions: UAE → France; France → UAE
- Media: Scena Conversations (podcast & video series)
- Social: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/scenagrowth/ ; Instagram https://www.instagram.com/scenagrowth/

## Services
- [Business Development](https://www.scenagrowth.com/business-development): We turn market opportunities into commercial relationships. Deliverables: Target mapping, Introductions & meetings, Partnership development, Pipeline & reporting.
- [Brand & Communication](https://www.scenagrowth.com/brand-communication): We adapt brands to new markets while protecting their identity. Deliverables: Brand strategy & positioning, Brand localisation, Packaging adaptation, Communication campaigns, Influencer marketing.
- [Retail & Distribution](https://www.scenagrowth.com/retail-distribution): We help consumer brands move from product to shelf. Deliverables: Retail strategy, Buyer meetings, Importers & distributors, Trade & shelf activation, Growth planning.
- [Media & Podcast](https://www.scenagrowth.com/media): We turn expertise and stories into influence. Deliverables: Podcast, Video, Founder stories, Market insights, Content system.

- [SCENA Real Estate](https://www.scenagrowth.com/real-estate): AI-assisted real estate visualization and property films. Turns supplied architectural plans into still visualizations, property films and pre-sales content for developers, agencies, architects and investors. Creative visualization for marketing and pre-sales — not technical construction documentation. The SCENA Residence example on the page is a fictional creative concept, not a client project. French version: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/real-estate
- Partner: Majlis Rare (luxury experiences & market activations in the UAE), integrated selectively; SCENA remains the sole strategic and commercial point of contact.

- Missions: Mission 1 — Market Assessment; Mission 2 — Market Entry Preparation; Mission 3 — Launch & Business Development. Engage the whole journey or only the missions needed.
- Offer structure: (A) Market Access & Business Development, (B) Distribution & Retail Development, (C) Fulfillment, Logistics & Market Operations — SCENA can act as importer of record without buying the brand's stock; storage and shipping are handled by a partner logistician; distribution to points of sale runs through a network of partner distributors selected and coordinated by SCENA. The brand keeps control of its price, stock and registrations. Engagement types: Market Test, Market Entry, Market Growth (Test → Enter → Grow). https://www.scenagrowth.com/retail-distribution#fulfillment

- [Montaji file preparation (Dubai)](https://www.scenagrowth.com/montaji-dubai): help scoping, organising documents, checking data and label consistency, preparing and coordinating Montaji product-registration files for Dubai Municipality. Scena is not an authority, certification body or approved representative; the official application is made by the eligible company; no registration or timeline is guaranteed. French: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/montaji-dubai
- [Beauty brand launch in France](https://www.scenagrowth.com/beauty-brand-launch-france): modular offer (market & pricing, first regulatory review and referral to specialists, packaging and content, importers/distributors/retailers, e-commerce, beauty advisors, sales and launch, Paris events). Scena does not act as EU Responsible Person. French: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/lancement-marque-beaute-france
- [Brands & partners](https://www.scenagrowth.com/brands-partners): only real, published relationships with their nature stated (currently Majlis Rare — partnership, UAE); B2B request form. French: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/marques-partenaires

## Directions
- [UAE → France](https://www.scenagrowth.com/uae-to-france): Scena Growth helps UAE companies enter and develop in the French market: research, positioning, brand and packaging localisation, communication, influence, retail, distribution and business development. Steps: UAE brand → French market research → Brand positioning → Packaging adaptation → Communication campaign → Influencer activation → Retail strategy → Distribution → French market launch.
- [SCENA Market Access](https://www.scenagrowth.com/market-access): Test the market before investing in it. A low-risk, performance-led model to test, enter and grow between France and the UAE without building everything from scratch: market potential → e-commerce (Shopify) → localised offer → content & creators → events & pop-ups → sales & distribution → local setup only if it works. French version: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/market-access
- [France → UAE](https://www.scenagrowth.com/france-to-uae): Scena Growth helps French companies enter and develop in the UAE: market strategy, business development, partnerships, communication, content, events, market access and international expansion. Steps: French company → Market assessment → UAE strategy → Local positioning → Business development → Partnerships → Local network → International expansion.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What does Scena Growth do?
  A: Scena Growth helps companies grow between France and the UAE. We combine market entry strategy, brand and communication, business development, retail and distribution, content, podcasts and events with one point of contact.
- Q: Can Scena help a UAE company enter the French market?
  A: Yes. For UAE brands we run French market research, positioning, brand and packaging localisation, communication and influencer campaigns, retail strategy, distribution and business development through to launch.
- Q: Can Scena help a French company expand into the UAE?
  A: Yes. For French companies we assess the UAE opportunity, define a local strategy and positioning, develop partnerships and commercial relationships, and support communication, content and events in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the wider GCC.
- Q: Does Scena guarantee funding or investment?
  A: No. Scena does not guarantee funding, investment or sales.
- Q: What is Scena Conversations?
  A: Scena Conversations is Scena Growth's podcast and video series featuring founders, investors, creators and builders working between France, the UAE and international markets.
